name: Windows 11
summary: In-browser recreation of the Windows 11 desktop: lock screen, desktop and draggable, resizable app windows.
description: A web recreation of the Windows 11 experience that runs in the browser: a lock screen and desktop with draggable, resizable windows and smooth animations. Built with React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui and Framer Motion; the source repo (85 stars) links back to win11.oimmi.com.
